data: BEGINNING OF CONVERSATION: USER: Who is the new executive chef at Chez Pannisse? ASSISTANT:

The new executive chef at Chez Panisse is Christopher Lee. He is a native of San Francisco and a graduate of the Culinary Institute of America. He most recently served as the executive sous chef at the acclaimed restaurant The Restaurant at Meadowood.
BEGINNING OF CONVERSATION: USER: How do I change my grade on a paper? ASSISTANT:

It depends on your school's policy. Generally, you will need to talk to your professor to request a change in grade. Your professor may require you to provide an explanation for the change or may grant the request based on your explanation.
